description: This file defines the 'DB' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library' namespace, acting as a database abstraction layer. It provides methods for establishing a database connection via different adaptors, executing queries, escaping values, and retrieving connection info such as last inserted ID and connection status.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Database abstraction class responsible for managing database connections and executing SQL operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided configuration options, validates required parameters, and loads the appropriate database adaptor class.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query using the underlying adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string to protect against SQL injection, using the underlying adaptor.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is currently active.
